reasons: The basket recurs through the miracle sequence: bread remains full in the basket, is offered to feed others, and later holds leftover pieces.
Miri, Yonah, and Nim actively gather pieces into it, then hand their basket to Andrew in scene 13.
It visualizes the story point stated on the hillside: twelve full baskets, “More than enough.”
story_role: the gathered leftovers proving abundance after the miracle
